description: A close English retelling of the Norwegian folktale, keeping the original chain of trades and the warm, comic domestic harmony where Gudbrand’s wife praises each choice—leading to a surprising wager and payoff.
tone: Folktale humor, warm and lighthearted, with gentle satire
summary: Gudbrand trades away a cow through a string of swaps until nothing is left, only to discover his wife’s unfailing approval wins him a wager.
